method: Safe regular-file archive extraction; no host execution of specimen programs.
Read source and decoded stages independently of atomscan verdicts.
PE headers/imports/sections and native disassembly; isolated bounded Unicorn decoder routines only, no OS/network APIs.
VirusTotal existing reports by hash only, no uploads. Used as corroboration for PEs, not verdict authority for scripts.
Official EDVR release hashes and exact Bloom vendor-download byte match.
limits: This is triage, not a proof that every source line is harmless. Source distribution reviews covered entry/build paths, flagged locations and coherent archive context.
Protected .NET inner payload and the Qt/manifest kit remain only partly reversed. Both lean hostile; no unsupported family/behavior traits added.
Several short PoCs have two or three suspicious findings rather than manufactured hostile traits. The user policy supplies the hostile training judgment.
NRV recovery is a memory-layout analysis image, not a pristine runnable reconstruction; imports are not rebuilt.
No observed NotPackedException was misreported as a UPX checksum validation failure.
